Reagents for reverse transcription are combined as in the table below. All following tables in this protocol have been calculated to a final volume of 50 μl and should be adjusted accordingly.

PBS is removed from SecureSeal chamber and combined reagents from table above added. Chamber inlets are sealed and slide placed in a humidity chamber. Any container to hold slides in place, lying flat and allow moisture retention will suffice. We use small slide boxes with wet (Milli-Q water) whatman paper in bottom of container. Combine reagents for Bridge-Probe hybridization as in table below.

Incubate Bridge-probe reagents for 1 hour at RT in dark, on rocker. 01:00:00, Bridge-Probe incubation All hybridizations (Bridge-Probe and detection oligos) at room temperature are performed on a slow, 360°, low angle rotation rocker to ensure distribution of reagents evenly on tissue sections.
Discard reagents and wash 2 times with 2XSSC. Let 2XSSC remain until next step reagents are prepared.

Then carefully remove as much liquid as possible from area surrounding tissue section. Use paper towel to dry area if needed. Then, with a hydrophobic pen, draw a barrier surrounding tissue section. After barrier has been drawn around tissue and dried slightly, apply additional PBS to section to prevent it from drying out and proceed to next step. We use ImmEdge Hydrophobic Barrier PAP Pen by Vector Laboratories (Cat. No. H-4000). Other hydrophobic pens have shown to impede the in situ sequencing visualiztion. It is also possible to reapply SecureSeal hybridization chambers instead of using hydrophobic pen for subsequent hybridization steps. We find it easier to continue all steps without the use of the chamber. Note that the same volume should be used on tissue sections as what the chamber volume was.

steps.title: Embed tissue in OCT and store
steps.instruction: Embed fresh‑frozen tissue samples in optimal cutting temperature (OCT) compound, then store the embedded blocks at –80 °C until cryosectioning.

steps.title: Cryosection and collect on slides
steps.instruction: Cryosection the OCT‑embedded tissue at 10 µm thickness (range 5–20 µm tested) onto SuperFrost Plus adhesion slides; slides may be kept at –80 °C until use.

steps.title: Thaw slides and air‑dry
steps.instruction: Remove slides from –80 °C, let them sit at room temperature (RT) for 3–5 min to air‑dry.

steps.title: Permeabilize sections with 0.1 M HCl
steps.instruction: Submerge each slide in ~20 mL of 0.1 M HCl (in H₂O) at RT for 5 min; then proceed to washing.

steps.title: Wash sections with PBS twice
steps.instruction: After HCl permeabilization, wash the tissue sections twice with phosphate‑buffered saline (PBS).

steps.title: Ethanol dehydration series
steps.instruction: Dehydrate sections to improve SecureSeal chamber adhesion: submerge in 70 % ethanol for 1 min, then in ~100 % ethanol for 1 min, and finally air‑dry.

steps.title: Mount SecureSeal hybridization chambers
steps.instruction: Place an appropriately sized SecureSeal hybridization chamber (e.g., small round chamber ~9 mm diameter, 0.8 mm deep, ~50 µL volume) over the dry tissue surface to obtain a proper seal.

steps.title: Fix sections with 3 % formaldehyde
steps.instruction: Prepare fresh 3 % formaldehyde in PBS and apply directly on top of the section on the flat slide; incubate either 5 min at RT (short fixation) **or** 30 min at RT (extended fixation) as required.

steps.title: Wash chamber with PBS‑T and PBS
steps.instruction: Apply PBS‑T to the chamber inlet, then perform a single PBS wash; leave PBS in the chamber until the next reagents are prepared.

steps.title: Post‑fixation with 3 % formaldehyde
steps.instruction: The next day, remove reverse‑transcription reagents, then postfix the tissue with 3 % formaldehyde in PBS for 40 min at RT (no intermediate wash). Afterward, remove PFA and wash the chambers twice with PBS, leaving PBS in the chamber.

steps.title: Incubate PLP at 45 °C
steps.instruction: After a 30 min incubation (presumably PLP), transfer the humidity chamber containing the slide to a 45 °C incubator and incubate for an additional 1 h 30 min.

steps.title: Wash off formaldehyde with PBS
steps.instruction: Discard formaldehyde solution, then wash the tissue section with PBS at RT; for a mouse coronal section, use ~200 µL of PBS per wash.

steps.title: Optional autofluorescence quenching with TrueBlack
steps.instruction: Prepare 20× TrueBlack Lipofuscin Autofluorescence Quencher (TLAQ) stock, dilute in 70 % ethanol to a 1× working solution; apply to the chamber and incubate at RT for 30 s–1 min (brain tissue 30 s–2 min acceptable). Remove TLAQ and wash PBS three times total, keeping PBS in the chamber.

substeps.instruction: Apply to chamber, incubate RT 30 s–1 min

steps.title: Wash with 2XSSC once
steps.instruction: Remove PBS from the section and wash once with 2×SSC buffer.

steps.title: Hybridize detection probes and incubate
steps.instruction: Combine detection‑oligo reagents as listed in the protocol table, apply to the section, and incubate in the dark at RT on a rocker for 1 hour.

steps.title: Wash after probe incubation
steps.instruction: After the 1‑hour incubation, wash the section with PBS twice.

steps.title: Mount with antifade medium and coverslip
steps.instruction: Remove PBS, add ~10 µL SlowFade Gold Antifade Mountant to the section, place a coverslip, and store slides at +4 °C in the dark (can be stored for several weeks).

steps.title: Image sections on fluorescence microscope
steps.instruction: Image the mounted sections using a fluorescence microscope (e.g., Zeiss Axio Imager.Z2) with appropriate filter sets; set up repeated imaging cycles with tile outlines saved for each round.

steps.title: Remove coverslip in PBS
steps.instruction: Submerge the slide with coverslip in clean PBS in a Coplin jar for a few minutes; then remove the slide, allowing the coverslip to slide off naturally or gently using forceps, and blot excess PBS.

steps.title: Wash to remove mounting medium
steps.instruction: Wash the section twice with PBS to eliminate residual mounting medium.

steps.title: Strip probes with 2XSSC washes
steps.instruction: Discard PBS and wash the tissue section five times with 2×SSC buffer.

steps.title: Prepare and pre‑warm stripping solution
steps.instruction: While the slide is submerged, combine stripping‑solution reagents (formamide‑based) as described in the protocol table, and pre‑incubate the solution and a humidity chamber at 30 °C until use. Also prepare 2×SSC washing solution (for 5 mL: 500 µL 20×SSC + 4.5 mL nuclease‑free H₂O).

steps.title: Incubate slide in stripping solution at 30 °C
steps.instruction: Place the slide in the pre‑warmed humidity chamber, apply the pre‑warmed stripping solution onto the section, and incubate at 30 °C for 30 min; keep any remaining stripping solution in the incubator.

steps.title: Post‑stripping washes with stripping solution and 2XSSC
steps.instruction: After 30 min, remove the stripping solution, wash once with the remaining stripping solution, then wash the section five times with 2×SSC.

steps.title: Remove SecureSeal chamber and final PBS wash
steps.instruction: Carefully remove the SecureSeal chamber using forceps, then wash the section once with PBS.

steps.title: Repeat cycles as needed
steps.instruction: Repeat the bridge‑probe / detection‑probe cycles (including hybridization, imaging, and stripping) until all combinatorial barcodes are decoded; store sections in PBS at +4 °C for short‑term or with mounting medium for long‑term storage between cycles.
